descriptionText:
Credence is seeking a Junior SAP ABAP Developer to support the development, integration, modernization, and maintenance of SAP enterprise applications in a federal government environment. The role focuses on SAP ABAP and S/4HANA development, enterprise integrations, testing, troubleshooting, and modernization initiatives.
Responsibilities
Develop, enhance, test, and troubleshoot SAP ABAP programs
Support SAP S/4HANA applications and enterprise system integrations
Assist with SAP interfaces using technologies such as OData, BAPIs, RFCs, and APIs
Collaborate with senior developers and functional teams to implement technical solutions
Support system testing, debugging, and issue resolution
Prepare technical documentation and maintain development records
Assist with SAP transports, deployments, and change-management activities
Participate in team meetings, code reviews, and Agile development activities
Skills
Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience
1-3 years of SAP ABAP development or related technical experience, including relevant internships
Foundational knowledge of SAP ABAP programming
Familiarity with SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA
Basic understanding of SAP interfaces and integration concepts
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills
U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance
Exposure to SAP S/4HANA, OData, BAPIs, RFCs, IDocs, or REST/SOAP APIs
Familiarity with SAP transports, testing, and change management
Experience supporting enterprise application modernization
Federal government or DoD experience
Active Secret clearance preferred but not required
Benefits
Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
Short Term & Long Term Disability
Training & Development
Wellness Resources
Company Overview
The proven national security AI company. It was founded in 2005, and is headquartered in Mclean, Virginia, USA, with a workforce of 1001-5000 employees. Its website is http://credence-llc.com.
